what_was_done: Added Precedence 2.5 block in interpretMarkerForRouting (src/lib/marker-routing.ts) that catches status=blocked when blocker_class is unset (undefined, null, or empty string). Returns {override: true, nextAgent: 'coherence', reason: 'status=blocked with no blocker_class, fallback to coherence safety net'}. This prevents the blocked marker from falling through to default pipeline progression (override=false), which would incorrectly advance the epic. Pre-mortem IF2 fix.
